verdict.rationale: A live probe returned HTTP 200 for https://developer.navan.com/llms.txt, which describes connecting AI assistants to Navan via MCP. Its content is plainly written for agents, covering VS Code MCP setup, authentication scope, and advice to keep payloads lean with date ranges and summary tools like `summarize_spend`. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of how agents actually use the llms.txt, and evidence of broader agent-oriented doc coverage (e.g. a full-content llms-full.txt or per-endpoint API markdown).
